items.text: Hi everyone,
Sorry for the late October update ^^. How are you all doing? I hope you’re all healthy and happy.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/7208e073fe09f5c0de03d78b991545f8a9499e38.png"]

October was a pretty tough month for both of us. We couldn’t work much on the games because of health issues that kept going back and forth between me and Estu. Thankfully, we’re both feeling better now and slowly getting back into development.

Even so, we still managed to push an update for the Cats Around Us: Yarn Ball demo so we could join Steam Next Fest. Based on feedback from one of the players who tried the demo, we added colored artwork.. you can find it in the Jigsaw Puzzle mode :D
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/fc4088972d54a51a1a9db834b17ce28450a73435.png"]

To be honest, this Steam Next Fest felt much quieter compared to previous ones. Many other developers have also mentioned the lower traffic. But that’s okay… we believe this is just part of the process, and Steam will eventually find a good solution for both developers and players.

Oh yeah, almost forgot.. we’ve already begun translating the cats in Yarn Ball. If you want to participate, feel free to check this link: https://steamcommunity.com/app/4255190/discussions/0/569301797587582026/
That’s the short (and late) update from us XD Sorry about the delay ^^
Have a nice day and stay healthy, everyone.
Love,
UB & Estu
Please help us by wishlisting our upcoming games ^^

Hi everyone!
How are you all doing? we hope everyone is happy and well.
And for those who might be going through a difficult time, we hope everything ends well soon.
We’re back with another monthly update from Noobzilla :D
Exactly one month ago, we released Cats and Seek: Zoo, and it has already received 20 reviews! Thank you so much for all the support and appreciation :D
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3992310/Cats_and_Seek_Zoo/"]Haven't left a review yet? Please help us by writing one ^^
Reviews really help more players discover the game!
Next update is about Cats Around Us: Yarn Ball.
We’ve just finished making the demo to join Steam Next Fest.
In this demo, I also tried adding a new mode called Binocular Mode :D Feel free to try it out!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4255190/Cats_Around_Us_Yarn_Ball/"]

And when we released Cats and Seek: Zoo, we also announced the next title in the CAU series.. Cats Around Us: Pizza Boy. Thank you to everyone who has supported it so far… Pizza Boy has already reached 500 wishlists! Yay!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/5108140/Cats_Around_Us_Pizza_Boy/"]If you haven’t wishlisted it yet, please do so ^^
Last update from us.. just a little sneak peek of what we’re currently R&Ding ^^
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/ce5c8d6c6db02f9240cf00f30bbf6dbeb9312760.gif"]
Wondering what this is? We can’t tell you yet ^^ Once the playable test is ready, we’ll try sharing it on our Patreon. If you haven’t joined yet, feel free to join now :D it’s free! ^^
That’s all for this month’s update.
Once again, thank you so much to everyone who has been supporting us ^^
Have a wonderful day and always be happy!
Love,
Estu & UB
PS: Don't forget to wishlist our upcoming games :D
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4255190/Cats_Around_Us_Yarn_Ball/"][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/5108140/Cats_Around_Us_Pizza_Boy/"]

Hi everyone!
First of all, we want to apologize because Cats and Seek: Zoo didn't make it out on its previously scheduled release date.

As we mentioned last month, UB ran into an issue with the final build submitted for Steam review that unfortunately couldn't be fixed in time for the scheduled release. We're really sorry for the delay.
The good news is the build has now been fixed and is currently being resubmitted to Steam for review!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3992310/Cats_and_Seek_Zoo/"]The new release date is scheduled for late August 2026. Hopefully everything goes smoothly this time and we'll all get to play it soon :D

Still on the topic of Cats and Seek: Zoo, we want to give a huge thank you to everyone who has been supporting the community translation project! Several languages are already in progress, here's the current status:
Romanian 100%
Spanish - Spain 100%
Spanish - LATAM 100%
Dutch 56.19%
French 70.15%
German 25.8%
Polish 31.45%
Turkish 76.15%
Ukrainian 2.13%
If you're interested in joining, feel free to drop a comment here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/3992310/discussions/0/567039101767792191/
In other news, Cats and Seek: Zoo is participating in the Monochropoly event! Monochropoly is a celebration of games where color is an artistic choice, not a limitation.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747822/9e07fc8e1e94f0242f0417f338a1e42080708ba2.png"]

Throughout the event, you'll discover a curated selection of games featuring distinctive visual styles, from entirely black-and-white worlds to carefully restrained color palettes, created by developers from around the world.
If you're into monochrome-style games, check out the event at this link: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/46149935-Monochropoly/sale/monochropoly2026
That's all for our quick update
Hope you all have a wonderful day and stay happy!
Love,
UB & Estu
PS : Dont forget to wishlist our upcoming games ^^

Hi everyone! April’s here already, so it’s time for a little update from us about what’s been happening over last month!

notes.title: All levels of Cats and Seek: Tokyo are ready!

items.text: Kamakura is the final level you’ll be able to explore through the DLC. So in total, there will be 5 levels (1 free, 4 in the DLC):
Asakusa (Free)
Akihabara
Ueno Park
Shibuya
Kamakura
You can check out a sneak peek of the levels on our Patreon post! 😺

This is a brand-new feature we added, inspired by the Eki Stamps we discovered while wandering around Tokyo last year. In Japan, a lot of train stations and tourist spots have special stamps you can use as souvenirs. We loved the idea so much that we added our own hidden stamps in Cats and Seek: Tokyo! You can find them, collect them, and use them to create your very own in-game artwork. 🎨
Yes! By the end of last month, we ran our very first community translation for Cats and Seek: Tokyo, and the response was amazing. We're super grateful for your support!
Thanks to everyone’s help, the game is now translated into 15 languages so far! 🎉
Brazilian Portuguese
Croatian
Dutch
Finnish
French
German
Italian
Polish
Romanian
Russian
Simplified Chinese
Spanish - Spain
Spanish - LATAM
Turkish
Ukrainian
Some other languages are still in progress too.

If you’d like to help translate a language that’s not done yet, or not started at all, feel free to hop into our community forum here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2925320/discussions/0/597396108583437769/

It’s April, which means it’s launch month for Cats and Seek: Tokyo! 😳 We’re a bit nervous, haha. There’s still a lot to double-check and polish. Once everything is ready, we’ll announce the official release date. Stay tuned!
Warm regards,
UB & Estu
Hello everyone!
Time flies and here we are in March 2025! Here's a little update on what's been happening since January.

As of today, 4 levels are ready to play! You can explore Asakusa, Akihabara, Ueno Park, and Shibuya. Estu is currently working on the final level, making a total of 5 levels in Cats and Seek: Tokyo. One level will be available for free with all its achievements, while the other 4 will be part of the DLC for those who want extra content. The DLC is available to wishlist now!

Back in January, we collaborated with Toge Productions to release Cats and Seek: Toge Land to celebrate their anniversary. We're so happy to see that the game has received 189 reviews so far! Thank you so much to everyone who played and left a review 🥰

We also tested an early prototype for another game series we're working on. So far, we've received more than 60 feedback submissions through the survey included in the prototype. Thank you so much to everyone who took the time to play and share your thoughts! If you're curious and want to try it out, you can check it out on our Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/posts/new-prototype-120037282
Thank you to the 180+ members who have joined our Patreon! We've been sharing sneak peeks of upcoming levels there, and we're so grateful for your support.

We also received a suggestion from one of our players about community localization. Currently, all cat descriptions are only available in English because there are so many of them, and professional translation would be too expensive for us. Meanwhile, AI translations often produce weird or awkward phrases.

I'm now looking into ways to set up a community localization system that would be easy for everyone to use. Once I figure it out, I'll share the details on Patreon. And if you're interested in helping, please join us! Our Patreon is free to join.
We're still counting on your support to wishlist our upcoming games! Your wishlist really helps us a lot.
That's all for now, thank you so much for being part of this journey with us! 😻
With love,
UB & Estu
